ignore-id.PKSA-z3gr-8qht-p93v: CVE-2026-24765: unsafe deserialization in PHPUnit's PHPT-format code-coverage handling. This repository has no .phpt-format tests, and unit-test.yml explicitly disables code coverage instrumentation (coverage: none), so the vulnerable code path is never reached. Ignored to allow a PHP-7.0/7.1-compatible phpunit/phpunit release to resolve.
ignore-id.PKSA-mh9b-91zm-m1gy: CVE-2026-45293: only affects the WordPress and WordPress-Extra rulesets' WordPress.WP.EnqueuedResourceParameters sniff, which this repository's phpcs.xml.dist does not use (it uses WordPress-Core and WordPress-Docs). Ignored to allow a PHP-7.0/7.1-compatible wp-coding-standards/wpcs release to resolve.
